# Security Policy

## Supported code

The `main` branch is the actively maintained development version. This project
does not currently designate other released versions as supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately using **Report a
vulnerability** on the repository's GitHub **Security** tab. Do not disclose
security issues in public issues, discussions, or pull requests.

If the private reporting option is unavailable, do not post vulnerability
details publicly. Contact the repository maintainers privately through GitHub
and ask them to enable private vulnerability reporting before sharing details.

Maintainers will acknowledge reports and respond when possible. No response or
resolution timeframe is guaranteed.

Repository maintainers: enable GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting in the
repository settings before publishing this policy.
